title: Following Clyde Hart in Kirby's band
summary: Billy Kyle was in the Army, and Ramirez followed Clyde Hart in John Kirby's group.

blocks.x: After you had this period with Frank, and you joined Kirby... Now, Billy Kyle...
Billy was in the Army. Clyde Hart I followed.
Well, how long were you with Kirby?
Oh, I don't know... It was the second time I
was... I was with him before he had that band. That was with the Palmer Brothers and Kirby.
